payload.title: Qualify checked raw access for every numeric ID type
payload.description: Qualification only. Positive: enumerate every current numeric ID wrapper and assert exact checked raw-access values and valid boundaries through current public APIs. Negative: every applicable out-of-range conversion has exact typed error; distinguish raw access from arithmetic/index conversion. Preserve vb-b5f as historical implementation and vb-jrco.9 as proof support; no implementation presumed missing.
